verses.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
verses.sm: Isaraelu ia te ta O lona fitu o tausaga, o lona lima foi o masina o le aso e sefulu o le masina, na o mai ai nisi toeaina O Isaraelu e fesili i le ALII, ua latou nonofo mai i oʻu luma.

verses.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Ona 00 mai ai lea o le afioga a le ALII ia te au, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.sm: Le atalii e o le tagata, fai atu ia i toeaina o Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia te i latou, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Aliile ATua, Ua outou o mai ea e fesili mai ia te au? O loo ola aʻu, ou te le mafai ona outou fesili mai ia te au, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii le ATUA.

verses.en: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.sm: E te le faamasino ea ia te i latou, le atalii e o le tagata, e te le faamasino ea? Faailoa atu ia ia te i latou mea e inosia na faia e O latou tama;

verses.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
verses.sm: ma ia e faapea atu ia te i latou, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATЧA, O le aso na ou filifili ai ia Isaraelu, ma ou sii ai loʻu lima i le fanau a le aiga o Iakopo, ma ou faailoaina atu o aʻu ia te i latou i le nuu o Aikupito, ina ua ou sii loʻu lima ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, O aʻu o le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.sm: O lea lava aso na ou sii ai loʻu lima ia te i latou e aumaia i latou ai le nuu o Aikupito e o atu i le nuu na ou sailia mo i latou, e tafe ai le suasusu ma le meli, ua sili ona matagofie o lea nuu i nuu uma.

verses.en: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Na au fai atu foi ia te i latou, la taitasi le tagata ma lafoai mea inosia ua i ona luma, aua foi le faaleaga outou ia te outou i tupua o Aikupito; o au o le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: A ua latou fouvale ia te au, ua le mafafai foi ona faalogo mai ia te au; ua le taitasi ma lafoaiina e i latou o mea inosia sa i O latou luma, ua le tuua foi tupua o Aikupito. Ona ou fai atu ai lea, Ou te sasaa atu lo‘u ita tele i luga ia te i latou, e faataunuu atu ai loʻu ita ia te i latou i le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: A e peitai na ou faia ona o loʻu igoa, ina ia le faaleagaina ai i luma o nuu ese sa latou i ai, na ou faailoaina atu ai foi aʻu ia te i latou i o latou luma i loʻu aumaia o i latou ai le nuu o Aikupito.

w.en: that they might not be destroyed.

verses.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.sm: Na ou aumaia i latou ai le nuu o Aikupito, ma ou taʻitaʻiina i latou i le vao.

verses.en: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.sm: Na ou tuuina atu foi ia te i latou aʻu tulafono, ma ou faailoa atu ia te i latou aʻu faamasinoga, O mea ia a faia e le tagata, e ola ai lava ia.

verses.en: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
verses.sm: Na ou avatu foi ia te i latou oʻu sapati, e fai ma faailoga ia te au ma i latou, ia latou iloa ai o aʻu o le Aw lē faapaiaina i latou.

verses.en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.sm: A ua fouvale le aiga o Isaraelu ia te au i le vao, ua le savavali i latou i aʻu tulafono, aualatou ‘ʻinoʻino i aʻu faamasinoga, o mea ia a faia e le tagata, e ola ai lava ia; ua latou matuā solia foi oʻu sapati. Ona ou fai atu ai lea, Ou te sasaa atu loʻu ita tele i luga ia te i latou i le vao e faaumatia ai i latou.

verses.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.sm: A e peitai na ou faia ona o loʻu igoa, ina neʻi faaleagaina ai i luma o nuu ese, na ou aumaia i latou i o latou luma.

verses.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.sm: O aʻu foi, na ou sii loʻu lima ia te i latou i le vao, Ou te le faaoo ia te i latou i le nuu na ou foaiina atu ai ia te i latou, e tafe ai le suasusu ma le meli, ua sili ona matagofie o lea nuu i nuu uma;

verses.en: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.sm: aua na latou ‘ino‘ino i aʻu faamasinoga, ma ua le savavali i au tulafono; a ua latou solia oʻu sapati, aua na mulimuli atu o latou loto i a latou tupua.

verses.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.sm: A e ui lava i lea na ou faasaoina i latou ia le fano i latou, ma ou le faaumatia i latou i le vao.

verses.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.sm: Na ou fai atu foi i a latou fanau i le vao, Aua tou te savavali i tu a o outou tama, aua foi le usiusitai i a latou masani, aua neʻi faaleagaina outou i a latou tupua.

verses.en: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.sm: O aʻu o le ALII lo outou Atua, ia outou savavali i aʻu tulafono, ma tausi i aʻu faamasinoga, ma outou faia.

verses.en: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: la outou faapaiaina foi oʻu sapati; e fai foi ia ma faailoga ia te au ma outou, ia iloa ai e outou, o aʻu lava o le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.sm: A ua fouvale le fanau ia te au; ua latou le savavali i afu tulafono, ma ua le tausi i aʻu faamasinoga ia usiusitai i ai, O mea ia a faia e le tagata, e ola ai lava ia; na latou solia oʻu sapati. Ona ou fai atu ai lea, Ou te sasaa atu loʻu ita tele i luga ia te i latou, e faaiuina atu ai loʻu ita ia te i latou i le vao.

verses.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.sm: A e ui lava i lea na ou faafoisia loʻu lima, ma ou faia ona o loʻu igoa, ina neʻi faaleagaina ai i luma o nuu ese na ou aveina atu ai i latou i o latou luma.

verses.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.sm: Na ou sii foi loʻu lima ia te i latou i le vao, Ou te faataapeapeina i latou i nuu ese, ma ou faasalalauina i latou i nuu eseese;

verses.en: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
verses.sm: auā na latou le faia aʻu faamasinoga, ma ua latou ʻinoʻino i aʻu tulafono, ma latou solia oʻu sapati, na faasaga foi o latou mata i tupua a o latou tama.

verses.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.sm: O le mea lea na ou tuuina atu ai ia te i latou o tulafono e le lelei, ma faamasinoga latou te le ola ai;

verses.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: na ou faaleaga foi ia te i latou i a latou lava taulaga i lo latou faaui ane i ulumatua uma i le afi, ina ia ou faatafunaina i latou, ina ia latou iloa o aʻu lava o le ALI.

verses.en: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, le atalii e o le tagata, ia e fai atu ai i le aiga o Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia te i latou, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, Na faifaia lava aʻu e o outou tama i lenei mea foi, ua latou matuā agasala lava ia te au.

verses.en: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.sm: Na ou aumaia i latou i le nuu na ou sii ai loʻu lima ou te avatua mo i latou, ona latou vaavaai atu lea i mauga maualuluga uma, ma laau tauuluuluola uma, na latou osi ai a latou taulaga, ma latou avatu ai a latou taulaga e faaonoono ai; na latou tuu atu ai foi a latou mea manogi lelei, ma latou liligi ai a latou taulaga i mea e inu.

verses.en: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu ai lea ia te i latou, Se a le mea maualuga tou te o atu i ai? Ua taʻua lona igoa o Le mea maualuga, ua oo mai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia e fai atu ai i le aiga o Isaraelu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai O le Alii le ATUA, Ua leaga ea outou e pei o le tu a outou tama? Ua mulilulua ea foi outou o mulimuli atu i a latou mea inosia?

verses.en: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.sm: Aua o lo outou avatua o a outou taulaga, ma lo outou faaui ane o a outou fanau i le afi ua outou faaleagaina ai outou i a outou tupua uma, ua oo mai i lenei aso; tou te fesili mai ea ia te au nei, le aiga o Isaraelu e? O loo fetalai mai ai le Alii le ATUA, O loo ola a‘u, Ou te le mafai lava ona outou fesili mai ia te au.

verses.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.sm: O le mea foi e tupu i o outou manatu, e le oo lava, ua outou faapea ane, E avea i matou e pei o nuu ese, e pei o aiga o nuu eseese e auauna i laau ma maa.

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le Alii le ATUA, O loo ola aʻu, ou te pule lava ia te outou ma le lima malosi, ma le lima faaloaloa, ma le ita tele ua sasaaina atu.

verses.en: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.sm: Ou te aumaia outou ai nuu ese, ma ou faapotopotoina outou ai nuu eseese ua faataapeapeina ai outou, ma le lima malosi, ma le lima faaloaloa, ma le ita tele ua sasaaina atu.

verses.en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.sm: Ou te aumaia foi outou i le vao o nuu, ma ou faamasino ja te outou i lea mea, o tatou o fesagai ma aʻu.

verses.en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: E pei ona Ou faamasino i o outou tama ile vao o le nuu o Aikupito, e faapea ona ou faamasino ia te outou, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii le ATUA.

verses.en: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.sm: Ou te faaui ane foi ia te outou i lalo o le tootoo, ma ou faaooina outou i le noataga o le feagaiga;

verses.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: ou te faate‘aeseina foi ia te outou O e fouvale, ma E agasala ia te au; ou te aveina atu i latou ai le nuu o loo latou aumau ai, a e latou te le o mai i le laueleele o Isaraelu; tou te iloa ai o aʻu lava o le ALII.

verses.en: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, O outou le aiga o Isaraelu; ia outou, ina taitasi ma auauna i ana tupua; a e mulimuli ane, afai tou te le faalogo mai ia te au, aua tou te toe faaleagaina lo‘u igoa paia i a outou taulaga ma a outou tupua.

verses.en: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.sm: Aua o lo‘u mauga paia, o le mauga maualuga i Isaraelu, o loo fetalai mai le Alii le ATUA, e auauna mai ai le aiga uma o Isaraelu ia te au, o i latou uma foi i le nuu; ou te talia i latou i lea mea, ma ou fai atu e au mai i lea mea a outou taulaga, ma mea faapolopoloina i a outou taulaga, atoa ma a outou mea paia uma.

verses.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.sm: Ou te talia outou ona o la outou mea manogi lelei, pe a ou aumaia outou ai nuu, ma faapotopotoina outou mai nuu eseese na faataapeapeina ai outou; e faapaiaina foi au e outou i luma o nuu ese.

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.sm: Tou te iloa o au lava o le ALII, pe a ou aumaia outou i le laueleele o Isaraelu, o le nuu na ou sii ai loʻu lima, ou te avatua i o outou tama.

verses.en: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.sm: Tou te manatunatu ai i a outou amio uma, ma a outou mea uma na fai, sa leaga ai outou; ona ‘ino‘ino ai lea. o outou ia te outou ona o a outou mea leaga uma ua outou faia.

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: E iloa foi e outou, o aʻu lava o le ALII pe a Ou faia ia te outou ona o loʻu igoa, e le tusa ma a outou amio leaga, ma a outou mea leaga ua fai, le aiga o Isaraelu e, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii le ATUA.

verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Ua oo mai foi le afioga a le ALII ia te au, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.sm: Le atalii e o le tagata, ia e faasaga atu ou mata i le itu i toga, ma faapati atu lau upu i le itu i toga, ma vavalo atu i le vao matua i le fanua i le itu i toga;

verses.en: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.sm: ma fai atu i le vao matua i le itu i toga, Faalogo mai ia i le afioga a le ALII, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, Faauta, ou te tútú le afi ia te oe, e susunuina ai laau mata uma ua ia te oe, atoa ma laau mamago uma; e le tineia le afi e mu saesae, e mu ai mata uma i le itu i toga, e 00 i le itu i matu.

verses.en: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.sm: E iloa foi e tagata uma o aʻu o le ALII, ua ou tútúina; e le tineia lava.

verses.en: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.sm: Ona vu fai atu ai lea, Aue, le Alii e le ATUA e!
